description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the GenericDelegator class, which is the default implementation of the Delegator interface in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting entity records, managing entity models and helpers, cache operations, transaction handling, and supporting entity event-condition-action rules.

classes.name: GenericDelegator
classes.description: The class implements the Delegator interface and provides core entity management functionalities, including CRUD operations, cache management, and event handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: initEntityEcaHandler
methods.description: Initializes the Entity ECA Handler if enabled; sets it up to handle entity event rule evaluation.

methods.name: createEntityEcaHandler
methods.description: Creates an instance of the configured Entity ECA Handler class using dynamic class loading.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity record based on primary key fields, optionally using cache and handling transactions and ECA rules.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of an entity record's fields based on the primary key.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns all records of a specified entity.

methods.name: findByAnd
methods.description: Finds entities matching exact field-value pairs.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Performs a find operation based on conditions, supporting entity conditions and options.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Finds a list of entities matching specified conditions, with caching and options support.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Returns an iterator over entities matching conditions, requiring a transaction context.

methods.name: getMultiRelation
methods.description: Traverses relationships between entities to retrieve related data.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Fetches related entities via a specified relation and fields filter.

methods.name: getRelatedDummyPK
methods.description: Constructs a dummy primary key for related entities based on relationship key mappings.

methods.name: getRelatedOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single related entity through 'one' or 'one-nofk' relations.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all entity caches, optionally distributing the clear command.

methods.name: clearCacheLine
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific entity or cache line based on fields, PrimaryKey, or value.

methods.name: clearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Flexible cache clear method for a dummy entity, supporting distribution.

methods.name: clearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Clears cache lines filtered by an entity condition.

methods.name: getFromPrimaryKeyCache
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the primary key cache.

methods.name: putInPrimaryKeyCache
methods.description: Stores a value in the primary key cache, respecting the entity's cache settings.

methods.name: putAllInPrimaryKeyCache
methods.description: Bulk cache insertion for a list of values.

methods.name: setDistributedCacheClear
methods.description: Sets the distributed cache clear interface.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads an XML document from URL and converts to entity values.

methods.name: makeValues
methods.description: Creates entity values from an XML DOM document.

methods.name: makePK
methods.description: Creates a primary key object from an XML element.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates an entity value from an XML element.

methods.name: getEcaRuleRunner
methods.description: Creates a rule runner for entity event condition-action rules.

methods.name: setEntityEcaHandler
methods.description: Sets the entity ECA handler object.

methods.name: getEntityEcaHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the current entity ECA handler.

methods.name: getNextSeqId
methods.description: Returns the next sequence ID as a string.

methods.name: getNextSeqIdLong
methods.description: Returns the next sequence ID as a Long.

methods.name: setSequencer
methods.description: Assigns a sequence utility for ID generation.

methods.name: refreshSequencer
methods.description: Refreshes the internal sequence utility reference.

methods.name: setNextSubSeqId
methods.description: Sets the next value for a sub-sequence ID, managing numeric padding and increments.

methods.name: encryptFieldValue
methods.description: Encrypts a field value based on the specified method.

methods.name: decryptFieldValue
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted field value.

methods.name: setEntityCrypto
methods.description: Sets the encryption utility for field encryption.

methods.name: cloneDelegator
methods.description: Creates an exact clone of the delegator with optional name change.

methods.name: makeTestDelegator
methods.description: Creates a test variant of the delegator, disabling ECA and enabling rollback.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Performs rollback of test operations during testing.
